name: @orbb/observability
description: Observability primitives for ORBB (architecture §2, §6): structured logging with injectable sinks, deny-by-default PHI redaction with stable hash pseudonyms, pure trace primitives, and route-pattern request log envelopes. Pure TypeScript — zero runtime dependencies, no provider SDKs (Sentry/PostHog adapters arrive in a later milestone via the @orbb/platform interface pattern).
